title: Palmly Today's Line (v1)
description: One day's reading of ONE feature (Audit-5 · 03 §2.1). Generated per (pulse_date × feature_key × locale), NOT per user — the day-pillar belongs to the DATE, and the personalization is which of the reader's own features is drawn today plus their own geometry lit beneath it. Reflective entertainment in the considered-scholar-friend voice; never health/medical/financial claims, never a prediction of real events. `essence` is the FREE line; everything below it is Premium (01 §6).

essence.description: The free line. Second person, names the feature, ≤90 chars so it fits the card's serif setting on a 320pt screen without truncation.

reading.description: 2–3 sentences reading this feature through the day's pillar.

career.description: One line, through this feature's lens.

watch.description: One line — what to keep an eye on. Never a warning about health, money or fate.

chapter_tone.description: One line usable INSIDE a chapter reading (Line Cycles), so the static catalog has a dated voice to sit beside.
